world.title: Rough Country
world.aphorism: Resistance persists where power reaches badly.

closing: A clean result may describe the rule more clearly than it describes the world.

beats.say: Trurl lays mountains in a box, and puts a capital on its western edge.
The state reaches out from the capital. Its reach falls with distance, and falls again in rough country.
Six cells of resistance are planted: three near the capital, three in the far mountains.

acts.fn: const P = V.patches.filter(p => p.i > 22).sort((a, b) => b.rough - a.rough); const out = []; for (const p of P) { if (out.every(o => Math.abs(o.i - p.i) + Math.abs(o.j - p.j) > 6)) out.push(p); if (out.length === 3) break; } return out.map(p => [p.i * 20 + 10, p.j * 20 + 10]);

beats.say: The sweeps begin. Near the capital the cells are cleared. In the mountains they spread.
Resistance persists where power reaches badly.
The map of the rebellion is a map of where the state is weak.
